Synopsis:
Havkelaag is a member of the Society of Brilliance, who is very interested in proving his theory of Genetic Morality.This dialog only ever plays in case players the gith kid massacre never happens.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_TheLodge_Havkelaag.json: Havkelaag is a member (and spokesperson) of the Society of Brilliance, an Underdark research collective obsessed with proving theories like his “Genetic Morality.” In this scene the player is speaking to him inside the Society’s quarters—he acts as a gatekeeper and politely refuses new admissions because the Society has suspended recruitment while the Absolutists bang on the city gates. He tells the player to use the downtime to prepare a long admission thesis (he jests “thirty‑thousand words”) and then prompts for further questions. This conversation only appears if the gith child massacre never occurred, so nearby events mentioned elsewhere (the gith creche on the roof, a skittish blue jay with baked goods, and an expeditioner seeking a githyanki egg) may be happening off‑screen and explain the Society’s interest in githyanki biology.
- UND_MyconidCircle_SocietyOfBrilliance_Scholar.json: The player meets Blurg, a hobgoblin (deep orc) member of the Society of Brilliance, a group of intelligent, neutral monsters working to improve the Underdark. He talks about his research and, if the tadpole is mentioned, brings his mind flayer friend Omeluum to talk to the player. The player can either agree to the mind flayer's help or attack.
- UND_SocietyOfBrilliance_Scholar_AD.json: Society of Brilliance Scholar idle looping AD - when he is alone or with the Mind Flayer. If the player spoke to the mind flayer but refused to let it see into their mind, a different AD plays.
- LOW_TheLodge_Omeluum.json: If the player has rescued Omeluum from the Iron Throne, then he is in the Lodge for the Society of Brilliance. He tells the player about the events that led him to be imprisoned on the throne, reflects on the outcomes of the rescue (whether the other hostages/Duke Ravengard were saved), and provides them with a reward for his rescue.
- LOW_Elfsong_Githyanki_InquisitorInterrogation.json: Dialog when the Githyanki in the Knights of the Shield hideout spots the player.
